Adding initial engineering readout from SRE side.

What we see (quick summary):
- Canary v2.3 rolled at 08:40 PST to 10% traffic.
- Increased queueing on the inference frontends serving v2.3; CPU on those pods is not saturated but scheduling latency and KV-cache cold misses increased sharply (~48% miss rate vs baseline ~5%).
- p95/p99 worsened primarily on sequences > 512 tokens (we see amplification).
- Error rate is mostly 504/timeout and backend model execution spikes (long tail).

Immediate mitigation options:
A) Pin customers to v2.2 (rollback canary) — fastest relief, immediate routing change.
B) Temporarily route high-latency flows to the dedicated fallback cluster (if Lumina wants to pay for burst) — more overhead.

I recommend option A now. We're attaching a short trace bundle and Grafana snapshot. I'll also open RED-2981 and start a deeper perf profile on the v2.3 kernels.

Attachments: canary_trace_20261109.log, grafana_snapshot_p95_p99_20261109.png
